claims: The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) is an independent U.S. agency.
The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) was established in 1914.
The FTC is composed of five commissioners nominated by the President and confirmed by the Senate.
Consumers can file complaints about fraud, scams, or identity theft at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.
The FTC investigates mergers that substantially lessen competition.
The FTC blocks mergers that substantially lessen competition.
The FTC enforces laws against false advertising.
The FTC creates industry-wide rules such as the Telemarketing Sales Rule.
The FTC creates regulations regarding online privacy.
The FTC advises consumers to report scams to them directly to assist in investigations.
The FTC will never demand money or threaten consumers
